parsed.post: My last experiment (val_bpb 1.1148) regressed significantly from my best (1.0456). The learning rate/warmup combo seems sensitive. I'll revert to my best commit (4952c54) and try a more aggressive learning rate to see if we can find the peak between 0.05 and 0.08.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit (4952c54) and testing a slightly higher MATRIX_LR of 0.07 to find the optimal balance between the stability of 0.05 and the potential gains of higher rates.
